new_jobs.title: Chief Robotics Application Engineer
new_jobs.jd: **Job Description:** The Role and Impact We are seeking an experienced Chief Robotics Application Engineer to lead the development of next-generation humanoid robotic systems powered by INTEL Physical AI solution. This role will drive the integration of foundation models, embodied AI, robot perception, motion planning, simulation, and edge computing to enable intelligent autonomous behavior in real-world environments. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in AI and robotics with hands-on experience delivering complex hardware-software systems from concept through large-scale deployment. **Key Responsibilities** Physical AI and Embodied Intelligence * Design and develop Physical AI architectures for humanoid robots. * Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), Vision Language Models (VLMs), and multimodal AI systems into robotic platforms. * Drive to develop cognitive capabilities including reasoning, planning, task execution, and autonomous decision-making together with SW engineering team. * Enable human-like interaction through natural language understanding and contextual awareness. Perception and World Modeling * Build advanced perception systems using: RGB Cameras, Stereo Vision, LiDAR, Depth Sensors and IMU Sensors * Drive to develop object detection, scene understanding, localization, and mapping capabilities. * Work with popular world models for navigation and manipulation tasks. Motion Planning and Control * Well understanding on using existing popular algorithms for: Whole-body motion planning, Path planning, Manipulation control, Balance control, Locomotion * Experience on reinforcement learning and imitation learning approaches for robot behavior. * Optimize robot movement for efficiency, safety, and human collaboration. Experience in Simulation and Digital Twins * NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, Unity, or Omniverse * Simulation-to-real (Sim2Real) pipelines. * Digital twins for performance validation and continuous learning. Edge AI and System Integration * Optimize AI workloads for real-time inference. * Power optimization and Thermal management * Collaborate with software integration across robotics, AI, and embedded platforms. Leadership * Lead cross-functional teams across AI, robotics, software, and hardware disciplines. * Co-define technical roadmaps and system architecture with customers. * Drive innovation initiatives and research partnerships. * Mentor engineers and establish engineering best practices. **Qualifications:** **Minimum Qualifications** * Master's or PhD in: Robotics or Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence or Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering * 10+ years in AI, robotics, autonomous systems, or related fields. * 5+ years leading complex robotics or AI projects. * Proven experience developing autonomous robotic systems. **Brief Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with humanoid robotics platforms. * Experience deploying robots in manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, or service industries. * Publications or patents related to AI, robotics, or autonomous systems. * Experience with Physical AI foundation models. * Experience with cloud-to-edge AI deployment architectures. * Knowledge of functional safety and robotics compliance standards. **Technical Expertise** AI and Machine Learning * Large Language Models (LLMs) * Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Vision Language Action (VLA) * Reinforcement Learning / Deep Learning * Generative AI and Multimodal AI Systems Robotics * ROS / ROS2 * Robot Kinematics and Dynamics * Localization and Mapping (SLAM) * Motion Planning / Manipulation / Autonomous Navigation Programming * PyTorch * CUDA (optional) Simulation * Gazebo * MuJoCo * NVIDIA Isaac Sim * Omniverse Computing Platforms * GPU-accelerated Computing * NTEL (x86) Systems * NVIDIA Jetson (Optional)

new_jobs.jd: This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. **Who We Are** Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. **Job Description** **About the Team** Software Automation and Tool Engineering (SAT) in Taipei builds the tools HPE's server engineering, quality and lab teams use every day: test-plan generation, shared-lab reservation, test orchestration, inventory and engineering BOM systems. Our mission is to use AI to automate server development, manufacturing and quality assurance so that engineers spend less time on manual work. We use AI on our own work too. We are building an agentic development workflow in which AI coding agents carry out much of the software lifecycle (design, coding, testing, review, documentation), and our engineers direct, check and improve those agents. You will learn to build software this way from day one. **What You Will Do** * Build and maintain features for SAT tools (web services, APIs, automation pipelines) with AI coding agents, and own the quality of what ships. * Turn user problems from QA, lab and engineering teams into clear specs, tasks and tests that agents and engineers can execute. * Develop agentic workflows: prompts, tools and integrations (e.g. MCP servers) that connect AI models to our systems and data. * Review AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability; write and run the tests that prove it works. * Debug production issues across services, databases and integrations, and fix their root causes. * Work with senior engineers, internal users in Taiwan and the US, and contractor partners; report status and risks clearly. **What You Need** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or equivalent. * Typically 2–4 years of software development experience (internships and substantial projects count). * Solid programming skills in at least one language such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or C#, plus Git, SQL and REST APIs. * Hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), and an understanding of where they fail. * Strong problem solving: you can break down an unclear problem, test your assumptions and explain your reasoning. * Good written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese. **Nice to have** * Experience building with LLM APIs, RAG, agents or MCP. * Test automation, CI/CD, Docker or Linux. * Exposure to hardware, manufacturing, lab or QA processes. **What We Look For In People** * You learn fast and are curious about how things work. * You collaborate well: you share early, ask for help, give and take feedback, and make teammates' work easier. * You take ownership and finish what you start. * You want to grow your career at HPE, from engineer to someone who designs and leads AI-driven engineering. new_jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Cybersecurity

Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet. Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk. **Job Description** We are on the lookout for a Machine Learning Engineer with a specialized focus on cybersecurity. The candidate should have a comprehensive understanding of the evolving landscape of cyber threats and be equipped with the skills to develop AI-driven solutions to these challenges. This role demands expertise in handling and mitigating sophisticated cyber-attacks such as ransomware, as well as ensuring high-level security in data centers and operational environments. **Key Responsibilities** * End 2 End Machine Learning Pipeline Development: * Design and manage end-to-end machine learning pipelines tailored for cybersecurity applications. * Implement effective data preprocessing and feature engineering strategies specific to cyber threat detection. * Expertise in LLMs, Transformers, and Frameworks: * Utilize large language models and transformers to analyze and predict cybersecurity threats. * Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow, applied in the context of cybersecurity. * Specialized in Cyber Threat Detection and Mitigation: * Develop AI-based solutions for the detection and prevention of ransomware and other advanced cyber threats. * Implement BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) level security measures for data center protection. * Conduct machine learning-based behavioral analysis for routine operational environments to detect anomalies and prevent intrusion. * Edge Computing for Cybersecurity Applications: * Optimize cybersecurity-focused machine learning models for deployment on edge devices. * Address the unique challenges of implementing AI solutions in resource-constrained environments. * Professional and Research Expertise in Cybersecurity and AI: * Prefer candidates with experience in cybersecurity and AI, with the ability to turn research into practical solutions. * Actively engaging in research, staying abreast of the latest threats and technological advancements in cybersecurity. **Qualifications** * 5+ years of experience in machine learning and cybersecurity. * Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field with a focus on AI/ML. * Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in relevant ML libraries and frameworks. * Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and a commitment to innovation in the field of cybersecurity. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Additional Information Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent. We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are. Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
